scope: Offline Trial-Window Feature Classification and Leakage Diagnostic Scope
equations: population_variance=sum((x-mean)^2)/n; sample variance is not the feature
centroid[class]=arithmetic mean of TRAIN features for that class
confusion rows actual A/B,columns predicted A/B; accuracy=diagonal/TEST count; balanced_accuracy=(recallA+recallB)/2 when both true classes present
TRAIN-majority baseline; ties A; same TEST IDs and denominators
Declared iid fair-binary arithmetic toy Pr(K>=8;n=10,p=1/2)=7/128; no empirical inferential claim
contract: Exact object fields; profile identity and catalog digest required. All opaque IDs ASCII1..64. schema_version/profile.version exact integer1. Canonical trial ordering by id; model hashes exclude TEST labels and TEST features. Input/report hashes retain complete request.

mode windows: each trial.values is channel-major array of 2..512 exact rational samples, all channels same length=end-start. mode features: length2*channels, declared mean/variance pairs, variances nonnegative; start/end still identify original synthetic interval. No mixed mode.

Exact rational inputs are integers (not bool) or canonical signed integer / positive integer strings with each component <=18 digits. Decimal strings, floats, exponent, zero/negative denominators and excess fields reject. Reduced output always Fraction string. Every arithmetic operation reserves numerator/denominator bits conservatively before multiplication/addition; >8192 bits rejects before that operation.

1..8 ordered unique channels with units arbitrary_units only; no inferred EEG units. task editorial_binary uses null annotations. task synthetic_imagined_hands_feet uses runs6/10/14, T1=A/hands,T2=B/feet. No other T1/T2 interpretation or real data supported.

2..256 unique trials; TRAIN and TEST required, VALIDATION optional and not used for fitting/scoring. Both TRAIN labels A/B required. Every label A/B supplied for retrospective scoring. TEST labels never enter centroids,predictions,training-majority or model hash. No learned scaling or hyperparameter search.

protocol subject_disjoint: subject IDs disjoint across TRAIN/VALIDATION/TEST. protocol within_subject_heldout_run: exactly one subject and disjoint run IDs across partitions. session must be null; no cross-session claim. run labels are not assumed sessions.

source_id identifies one synthetic file and maps to one subject/run. (subject,run,trial_id) dependent groups stay in one partition. A source interval [start,end) may not overlap another in a different partition; duplicate source windows reject even under different IDs. Same numeric features alone do not establish leakage.

Integer synthetic global-clock start/end/available_at/predict_at/label_available_at and fit_at in0..1000000000. start<end<=available_at<=predict_at. TRAIN window and label available by fit_at. TEST/VALIDATION predict_at>=fit_at and label_available_at>predict_at. This encodes declared availability only, not externally witnessed timing.
filter must be none. Noncausal, zero-phase or future-sample preprocessing unsupported. No post-outcome input availability in earlier predictions; no live or pre-decision neural claim.

Provenance synthetic=true, rights=self_authored, source_ref in frozen catalog, nonempty attribution/snapshot <=4000characters and exact UTF8 snapshot SHA256. Declarations/hashes are not independent rights or truth certification.

Preflight total raw sample/feature cells<=262144, feature dimension<=16, distance/fit reserved operations<=5000000, output reservation trials*(2*features+32)<=100000. All numeric inputs validated before fitting. Resource error returns no partial result.

Absent true TEST class: accuracy exists, that class recall=null and balanced_accuracy=null,status=not_estimable. Majority baseline fitted only on TRAIN. No automatic p-value/CI or claim of superiority. Fixed iid7/128 toy separately labeled arithmetic only.

supported: Exact mean/population variance and TRAIN-only centroids
Exact matched evaluation and deterministic JSON/Markdown
experimental_research_only: Interpreting toy features as neural or behavioral intention information
unsupported: Live BCI or unrestricted intention prediction
